description: LEGO Succulents (10309) vs official product render. The centre of the purple lotus has a red round piece where the set uses a grey one. Confirmed by the builder. Note the spiky aloe leaves also read aqua here against sage green in the render — that is the render, not the build, and it is a trap: an issue reported there is not a defect.

defects.label: red piece in the centre of the purple lotus, should be grey

ignore.label: aloe leaves photograph aqua but match the set; the render is the outlier
